title: console: list quick-search and the record picker offer search on an object with no searchable field, which objectstack now answers 400 INVALID_FIELD (objectstack#24284)
body:
Filing-gate category ①: a consumer follow-up owed by landed platform work. The sites are named below.

- **Reader who acts:** objectui triage grades it and routes it to the lane that owns `plugin-list`, `plugin-grid` and `fields`.
- **Dedupe:** two semantic searches over this repository's issues, closed included, found no card for this:
  - "list quick search box shown on object with no searchable fields, search returns 400 INVALID_FIELD, hide search when resolved search set is empty": 2 hits;
  - "record picker type-ahead search junction object no searchable field searchableFields console": 9 hits.

  The nearest are #3047 and #10713, both closed, and neither is this.

## What changed on the platform

objectstack-ai/objectstack#24284 landed as PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#24320 (`ec749fbb44` on objectstack `main`). A non-blank `search` on an object whose resolved search set is empty now answers `400`. Before, it answered `200` with every row, as if everything matched.

That object has no textual or enum stored field and no `searchableFields` declaration naming one. A junction object made of two lookups and a composed formula title is the common shape. The response carries:
- `error.code` `INVALID_FIELD` and `param: 'search'`;
- a message naming the object and the two remedies: declare `searchableFields` naming a stored field, or mirror the composed title onto a stored text field.

## The console's sites, read at the pinned `.objectui-sha` `0707b4ae37`

- `packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx`, about line 1607: `showSearch: ua?.search !== false && !searchlessViewOnScreen`. The quick-search box is shown unless `userActions.search === false`, and nothing consults the object's resolved search set.
- `packages/fields/src/widgets/useRecordQuery.ts`, about line 200: the record picker sets `params.$search` from the typed term.
- `packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx`, about lines 2955–2962: the grid sends `$search`, and sends `$searchFields` only when the view declares `searchableFields`.
- `packages/data-objectstack/src/index.ts`, about line 4925: `$search` goes out as `GET /api/v1/data/OBJECT?search=TERM`.

So on such an object the console offers a search that the server now refuses.

## Expected

- The console hides quick-search and the picker's type-ahead when the object's resolved search set is empty. `resolveSearchFieldResolution` from `@objectstack/spec/data` gives that set, read over the object schema with `internal: true` fields left out (the set the engine scans).
- Where a search box still shows, the console renders the refusal's message, never an empty or unchanged list.

It becomes user-visible once this repo's objectstack pin is at or past `ec749fbb44`.
